title: Model magic item extradimensional containment, portals, and inter-item interactions (M6+M11)
description: Implement families M6 (10 rows) + M11 (9 rows) from docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/2026-07-06-o9bd-18-7-7-3-magic-item-mechanics-inventory.md §4. M6: bag-of-holding, bag-of-devouring, efficient-quiver, handy-haversack, portable-hole, mirror-of-life-trapping (flagship: 12-cell containment with trap/release/overflow procedures), iron-flask, robe-of-stars, rod-of-security, well-of-many-worlds. Shape: capacity/occupancy state + entry/exit/rupture/suffocation procedures. M11 inter-item semantics: extradimensional nesting -> astral gate destruction (bag/haversack/hole), hammer-of-thunderbolts attunement precondition on belt-of-giant-strength + gauntlets-of-ogre-power, sovereign-glue <-> universal-solvent / oil counter-agents, talisman-of-the-sphere <-> sphere-of-annihilation. Inter-item preconditions extend the attunement model (Phase 1 F5). Recommended agent: Opus 4.8 design, Codex rollout.
notes:
2026-07-08 ADR 0017 adjustment: Containment/portal/inter-item clauses are good candidates for declarative source-grounded curated specs because memberships are irregular and clause-reviewed. The spec must be locator-bound, schema-validated, parity-checked, and drift-failing; live occupancy/cell/rupture state remains runtime state, not generated output.
Implemented the source-grounded family projector, strict schema validation, clause registry bindings, generated pack projection, and representative/exhaustive tests. The exact 240-row owner-tag conservation census passes; all magic items now carry reviewed executable mechanics.
close_reason: Source-faithful executable magic-item family complete; canonical regeneration, conservation gates, deep audit, and full worktree verification pass.
